messages:
Maria P.: Heads-up — bringing up compact int4 variant (v3-compact-int4) in canary. Quick summary of what we saw in the first 10k requests.
Jon K.: Thanks. Raw numbers from the AB: baseline v2p1 (float16) MRR=0.742, median latency=42ms, p99=190ms. v3-compact-int4 MRR=0.721, median latency=38ms, p99=210ms.
Samir: So latency improved slightly median but p99 worsened ~10%. MRR drop ~2.8% absolute relative to baseline (2.8% / 0.742 ~ 3.8% rel).
Jon K.: Also saw a small hallucination bump on long-doc slices: hallucination_rate baseline=0.45%, int4=1.05% (delta +0.6%).
Maria P.: Our canary rules in prod say auto-fallback if any of: MRR drop >1.5% absolute OR hallucination delta >0.5% OR p99 latency >1.5x baseline. We're past two thresholds.
Samir: Agreed. Proposed immediate actions: 1) Pause ramp (hold at current 2% traffic), 2) trigger canary auto-fallback for the canary pool, 3) run targeted long-doc eval corpus (seeded 3k samples).
OpsAnna: @here I can run the long-doc eval on dedicated infra, ETA ~30m. Also can snapshot KV warmup differences.
DevBot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback invoked by @Maria P. — rolling traffic back to v2p1 for canary pool. Roll ID: rb-20260321-77.
Maria P.: Config we used for the roll (for reference):
```yaml
rollout:
  mode: canary
  start_pct: 0.5
  step_pct: 1.5
  max_pct: 10
  metrics:
    - name: mrr
      compare: absolute_drop
      threshold: 0.015
    - name: hallucination_rate
      compare: absolute_delta
      threshold: 0.005
    - name: p99_latency
      compare: ratio
      threshold: 1.5
```
Jon K.: After rollback, plan: repro on staging with identical seq-lens + KV warmup, try hybrid-quant knob (symmetric 4-bit vs nf4) and re-run the small-batch burn-in.
Samir: If repro fails, we'll mark the variant as `holdback` and add to watchlist, then consider partial quant profile (int8 for long-doc slice).
Maria P.: Filing quick postmortem note after targeted evals. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
